analysis.analysis: R-073: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger: Visited link. Outcome: Recorded to Global History. R-074: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger: Server redirect. Outcome: Correct link recorded to Global History. R-075: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger: Clicking on a history link. Outcome: Launched in a browser window. R-076: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger: Delete request. Outcome: History entry shall be deleted. R-077: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger: Delete request for multiple entries. Outcome: Multiple History entries deleted and no longer displayed. R-078: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger: Clear request. Outcome: Global History shall be cleared. R-079: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger 1: Group by Day. Outcome 1: History items grouped by Day. Trigger 2: Group by Site. Outcome 2: History items grouped by Site. Trigger 3: Group by None. Outcome 3: History items grouped by None. R-080: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger 1: Sort per column. Outcome 1: History sorted per column. Trigger 2: Reverse-sort per column. Outcome 2: History reverse-sorted per column. R-081: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger: Resizing history columns. Outcome: Columns resize to show/hide more of entries. R-082: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger 1: Show column. Outcome 1: History columns shown. Trigger 2: Hide column. Outcome 2: History columns hidden. R-083: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger 1: Back button dropdown menu use. Outcome 1: Recently visited sites re-visited. Trigger 2: Forward button dropdown menu use. Outcome 2: Recently visited sites re-visited. R-084: Multiple distinct behaviors, Normal scenario warranted. Trigger 1: New browser window creation. Outcome 1: New, empty session history file created. Trigger 2: Browser restart. Outcome 2: New, empty session history file created.
